description: Defines classes and functions for a libevent-based implementation of QuicEventLoop, including factory and ownership management, for use within the quic namespace.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop
classes.description: Implements a libevent-based QuicEventLoop with support for socket registration, event handling, and alarm creation.

classes.name: LibeventLoop
classes.description: RAII wrapper around an event_base, managing its lifetime.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoopWithOwnership
classes.description: Extends LibeventLoop and LibeventQuicEventLoop, owning the event_base.

classes.name: QuicLibeventEventLoopFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing instances of libevent-based QuicEventLoop, with options for level-triggered backend.

classes.name: AlarmFactory
classes.description: Inner class for creating QuicAlarm instances.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: Manages socket registration and event notification for a specific socket.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop
methods.description: Constructor initializing with an event_base and clock.

methods.name: SupportsEdgeTriggered
methods.description: Indicates if edge-triggered mode is supported.

methods.name: CreateAlarmFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for alarms.

methods.name: RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with the event loop.

methods.name: UnregisterSocket
methods.description: Unregisters a socket.

methods.name: RearmSocket
methods.description: Re-arms a socket for event notifications.

methods.name: ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Simulates an event notification for a socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs the event loop once with a specified timeout.

methods.name: GetClock
methods.description: Returns the associated QuicClock.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the event loop from another thread.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Returns the underlying event_base.

methods.name: clock

methods.description: Creates a QuicAlarm with a delegate and arena.

methods.name: Registration::ArtificiallyNotify
methods.description: Notifies the registered socket of an event.

methods.name: Registration::Rearm
methods.description: Re-arms the socket for events.

methods.name: LibeventLoop
methods.description: Constructor and destructor managing event_base lifetime.

methods.description: Creates an instance owning the event_base.
